title: fullcycle names a dev-profile build as the cause and gives a second remedy when the build itself failed
body:
Found by critic-shell reviewing the fix for issue `0068` on 2026-09-16, by reading the code. Not reproduced in a run.

When `build all` FAILS after a passing clean and a watched PATH link is dark, `lib/cmd/fullcycle` prints two remedies for one state:

- the loop's branch: `THE BUILD TREES WERE ALREADY REMOVED AND HAVE NOT BEEN REBUILT` ... `Rebuild before doing anything else: bin/devbin build all`;
- the after-half link check, which is not gated on `rc`: `The build phase did not repopulate release/ -- a dev-profile build does not.` then `Rebuild with a RELEASE profile before doing anything else.`

The second names a cause that is false for this run -- the build did not run at a dev profile, it failed -- and a remedy that differs from the first.

## Why it is worth an issue

Same class as `0068`: text read at the moment a cycle has gone wrong, stating a mechanism that did not happen. An operator told to switch profiles goes looking for a configuration problem that does not exist.

## Shape of a fix, not a ruling

Word the link check's cause and remedy from whether a build passed since the clean (`rebuilt`, from `0068`): a failed build keeps the loop's remedy and the link check only lists the links; a passing build keeps the dev-profile wording. Hold it with an arm: build fails after a passing clean with a watched link dark, and the output carries one remedy.
